references.text: Isaiah criticizes the people's false piety, which mirrors Jesus' criticism of the Pharisees' attitudes in Mark 7.
Jesus teaches that it is not what enters the mouth that makes a person unclean, but what comes out of the heart, paralleling Mark 7:19.
Peter's vision of clean and unclean animals and the message that God has declared all foods clean underscores Jesus' teaching in Mark 7:19.
God's command to Peter not to call anything unclean that God has cleansed echoes Jesus' words in Mark 7:19 that all foods are clean.
